decisions: Use flat colors only; no gradients.
Use black #000000 in place of the original blue for headings, links, highlights and brand surfaces.
Flare Green #8BE67D sparingly for CTAs and accents.
Ink #0E1330, Paper #F8F7F3, Charcoal #2F393D and white are the neutral palette.
Plus Jakarta Sans 600/700 for headings and Inter 400/500/600 for body copy.
Use the 9, 12, 16, 21, 28, 38, 51 and 67px type scale with fluid clamp sizing.
Favor spacious editorial layouts, visible proof and subtle purposeful motion.
Use a flat full-width editorial header with a thin divider; avoid floating card-style navigation.
Use a compact black editorial hero with no decorative grid, oversized icon or full-viewport height.
Use flat rectangular buttons with 44px minimum height, compact typography and no rounded corners.
Use the OriginKit hero-13 image tunnel as a full-screen, edge-to-edge Recent Works presentation powered by real portfolio covers.
Present services as a flat numbered editorial grid with small, consistently framed service icons.
Use the square KreativeTab logo cursor inside Recent Works, a compact monochrome arrow cursor across the website, and a matching custom monochrome hand cursor for clickable controls.
Use a compact flat footer with a Flare Green project CTA band above a structured black information and legal area.
